name: hazel_weir_velocity_procedural_graph
description: Optimized Procedural Graph featuring capital-velocity liquidations, hyper-fertilized Strawberry compounding, strict Town Shop arbitrage, and cluster-harvest workforce routing with strict wage-drain prevention.

nodes.name: State & Balance Audit
nodes.description: Computes net available cash, shed fill percentage, wage liability, active shop contract demand, and oracle price drop signals across market commodities.

nodes.name: Midnight Wage Reserve Defense
nodes.description: Protects payroll for all active hired hands. Enforces dynamic cash reserve locks and triggers pre-midnight surplus liquidation to prevent the 0-hand bankruptcy cascade.

nodes.name: Town Shop Demand Arbitrage
nodes.description: Fulfills active town shop contracts for 2.0x-3.5x premiums. Procures exact seed quantities for active shop demands (Carrots, Tomatoes, Pumpkins) to avoid over-commitment, while routing all uncontracted surplus to open-market sales.

nodes.name: Oracle Opponent Front-Run
nodes.description: Reads 96-step TTM forecast to dump sensitive commodities (Wool, Milk, Strawberry) immediately before opponent market gluts collapse prices.

nodes.name: Capital Velocity & Liquidation
nodes.description: Abolishes shed hoarding by executing continuous batch liquidations of uncontracted surplus inventory at favorable market prices, unlocking fluid cash for reinvestment and preventing idle physical stock from bottlenecking farm economy compounding.

nodes.name: Capital Reinvestment & Yield Scaling
nodes.description: Reinvests surplus cash into workforce scaling (up to 7 hands), calibrated land expansion (14 plots max by Day 16), and hyper-fertilized recurring cash crops (Strawberries) for maximum multi-harvest yield compounding.

nodes.name: Routine Farm & Workforce Execution
nodes.description: Executes field routines with cluster harvesting to minimize transit waste. Prioritizes watering and planting above shed drop-offs to eliminate growth-pausing dry intervals and empty plots, maximizing plot productivity.

attributes.guidance: Cancel non-essential purchases; schedule worker harvest drop-offs before hour 21; enforce emergency liquidation of non-feed, non-contract inventory at hour >= 20 to guarantee payroll.
attributes.pitfalls: Never sell Wheat below dynamic livestock feed reserve (max(4, n_animals * 3)); never liquidate crops committed to active town shop delivery.

attributes.condition: has_unlocked_shops and (shop_deliverable_inventory > 0 or (net_available_cash >= 150.0 and active_shop_demand > 0)) and day <= 30
attributes.guidance: Allocate market slots to deliver exact matching inventory to town shops for 2.0x-3.5x premium through step 710. Procure exact seed quantities (Carrots, Tomatoes, Pumpkins) strictly to fulfill active, unlocked shop contracts.
attributes.pitfalls: Do not hoard inventory speculatively for future unrevealed contracts; instantly release uncontracted surplus to open-market liquidation. Do not buy shop seeds if net cash falls below 1.25x midnight payroll.

attributes.guidance: Preempt lowest-margin open orders; execute rapid batch liquidations of vulnerable commodities (Wool, Milk, Strawberry) while current market price remains favorable (> 0.70 * base_price) before opponent dumping collapses market prices.
attributes.pitfalls: Do not dump into already collapsed sub-0.50 base price markets unless shed overflow is imminent; do not front-run commodities committed to active town shop contracts.

attributes.guidance: Execute batch sales of unreserved, non-shop surplus holdings when market price >= 0.85 * base_price, or when shed occupancy hits 25% to maintain capital velocity. Relax price floor to 0.60 * base_price if shed_used >= 80.
attributes.pitfalls: Never liquidate exact item quotas reserved for active town shop contracts. Never sell Wheat below dynamic livestock feed reserve (max(4, n_animals * 3)).

attributes.condition: net_available_cash >= midnight_payroll_due * 1.5 + 100.0 and (hired_hands < 7 or (uncultivated_plots > 0 and day <= 16) or has_fertilizer_deficit) and day <= 26
attributes.guidance: Scale workforce to a strict maximum of 7 hands to eliminate idle wage drain. Gate contiguous land expansion to 14 plots only when hands >= 5, cash > 2.0x payroll + plot cost, and day <= 16. After early Carrot bootstrap, transition 100% of non-shop acreage to hyper-fertilized Strawberries for maximum multi-harvest yield compounding.
attributes.pitfalls: Never hire more than 7 hands. Never expand land beyond 14 plots or after Day 16. Do not plant slow single-harvest crops (Pumpkins, Tomatoes) unless explicitly demanded by an active town shop contract. Ensure persistent fertilizer procurement for all Strawberry plots.

attributes.guidance: Dispatch hands using cluster harvesting: workers must harvest adjacent ready plots up to inventory capacity. Priority sequence: 1) Cluster Harvest, 2) Water dry crops, 3) Plant seeds, 4) Drop off at shed, 5) Feed livestock, 6) Weed/Till. Ensure all carried inventory is deposited by step 716.
attributes.pitfalls: Never deprioritize watering or planting below shed transit, as dry or empty plots halt growth. Do not allow 1-crop transit cycles that waste worker steps. Ensure hands never idle while unharvested crops, empty plots, or dry plots remain.
